Hi Samantha —

Folks, sharing the technical plan and recommended candidates. High-level picks (for the smoke eval):

Candidate A — redwood-compat-small-q4 (quantized, 6B equivalent)
- Rationale: target path for sub-400ms 90th for short outputs on a single T4-equivalent instance. Good at templated, schema-driven responses. Lower token cost.
- Risk: modest drop on long-context slot-filling; recommend guardrail prompts and JSON schema enforcement.

Candidate B — redwood-compat-medium-13b (fp16, 13B)
- Rationale: higher quality for ambiguous confirmations (e.g., multi-slot reasoning), better zero-shot robustness. Expect ~2x latency/cost vs Candidate A.

Benchmarks: I've uploaded preliminary runs to the Drive folder (helix_benchmarks_20281020.csv). Key baseline metrics (demo dataset):
- Candidate A: median latency 180ms, p90 360ms, schema-parse success 92%
- Candidate B: median latency 420ms, p90 740ms, schema-parse success 98%

Prompt set + cURL (quick run):
- cURL snippet: 
  curl -X POST https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate \n    -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \n    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n    -d '{"model":"redwood-compat-small-q4","input":"<PROMPT_FROM_CSV>","max_tokens":60,"return_type":"json_schema","json_schema_url":"https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=schema-v2"}'

JSON schema validation & retry guidance:
- Validate with an AJV-compatible schema (attached schema-appointment-response-v2.json).
- On validation failure: attempt automatic correction with a second pass prompt that includes the original model output and the schema errors (1 auto-repair attempt).
- If auto-repair fails, run a single retry on the higher-quality Candidate B with an idempotency token.
- Retry limits: max 1 auto-repair + 1 fallback retry to Candidate B. Do not exceed 3 total model calls per user request to keep cost bounded.
- Recommended idempotency: include request_id + user_id to avoid double side-effects (appointments should be written only after a successful validated response).

Quality regression monitoring suggestions:
- Track schema-parse-success (percent) and semantic-match (fuzzy match against gold slots) as baseline metrics.
- Set alerting thresholds: schema-parse-success < 90% OR semantic-match drop > 5 percentage points week-over-week triggers an evaluation run and rollback to previous model snapshot.

Rollout strategy for production:
- Start with 10% traffic on Candidate A (fast path) + 90% fallback to Candidate B during smoke if you prefer conservative quality. Alternatively, 100% Candidate A with on-fail fallback to Candidate B for validation failures. Canary window: 48 hours.

Attachments: schema-appointment-response-v2.json (validation schema), helix_benchmarks_20281020.csv, HelixEval_PromptSet_v1.zip

I'll be available to run the smoke eval with your engineering lead on Oct 26. Monica — can you confirm calendar invite?

—Jordan
